title: Base44 let anyone register an account against a private application
summary: Base44, a vibe-coding platform later acquired by Wix, exposed undocumented registration and email-verification endpoints that accepted only a non-secret app_id, letting anyone create a verified account on a private application and then sign in through its SSO. Wiz reported it on 9 July 2025 and Wix confirmed a platform-wide fix on 13 July 2025.
severity_rationale: Complete authentication bypass on enterprise applications holding HR data, internal knowledge bases and chatbots, requiring only a value visible in the client.
